context.title: Analysis context
context.help: All messages are used by default. Selected message bodies and background together are limited to 20,000 characters; reduce the range or shorten the content if needed.
context.priorPlaceholder:
me: An earlier message
other: Their reply at the time
context.backgroundPlaceholder: For example: We are discussing next week’s plans.
context.safetyNote: Supplements stay in memory only. Clear them manually, or they are cleared when switching the bound target window or exiting. Contact changes in the same window cannot be detected; clear supplements yourself. Transaction checks cover all input.
context.tooLong: Selected message bodies and background together, or an individual input, exceed 20,000 characters. Reduce the range or shorten the content.
context.invalidMessageLimit: Choose all messages or the last 10, 20, or 50.
binding.windowHelp: New selections follow window movement by default. Across different DPI, geometry must remain consistent; size changes over 2 DIP require reselection. Visible chat only; no background OCR.
binding.screenHelp: The selection stays at fixed screen coordinates. Reselect after moving the window or changing displays.
binding.confirmHelp: Choose and verify the target window. Confirmation is required after closing the target or restarting. Contact changes in the same window cannot be detected; clear supplements yourself.
binding.noCandidates: No candidate windows are available. Open the target window and refresh.
binding.fixedRequired: Select a fixed screen area first.
binding.none: No target window is bound. Select the chat area first.
binding.needsConfirmation: The target closed or needs confirmation. Choose a candidate window.
binding.invalid: The window binding is invalid. Reselect or confirm the target.
binding.unavailable: The target window is unavailable. Restore it and make the chat area visible.
binding.reselectRequired: The window size or geometry changed. Reselect the area.
binding.offscreen: The chat selection is outside the screen. Reselect the area.
binding.occluded: The chat area is occluded. Move overlapping windows and try again.
binding.changed: The target window or binding changed during capture. The screenshot was discarded; try again.
binding.candidateExpired: The candidate expired. Refresh and choose again.
binding.selectFirst: Select the chat area and bind its window first.
binding.invalidMode: Invalid selection mode. Choose Follow window or Fixed screen area.
